summary: No-stopping kerb at a signalised junction on busy Musgrave Road.

drivers.seclusion: Car park structure behind, flats 20 m across the road; public.
drivers.access_and_room: Short kerb at a junction mouth with a painted island; no room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with turning lanes.
drivers.convention: No stopping signed; no cars parked along the kerb.

sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees to the west give some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: Musgrave Road east kerb just north of the shopping centre exit
